put.summary: Create or rebind a versioned Asset mapping
put.description: Requires data:read AND data:design and current entity read access. expectedRevision0 creates revision1; every accepted mutation increments revision. Active external IDs unique within organization/provider. Archived entities reject mutation. Only the current JWT organization Asset URN is accepted; no query.

get.description: Requires data:read and current entity read access. HTTP200 statuses: not_linked (no active mapping), source_unavailable (read opt-in disabled or relation absent), no_observation (relation exists, scoped row absent), fresh or stale (observedAt older than300s). Null observation for first three states. Source query failure returns HTTP503 code source_unavailable; malformed provenance/status/timestamp returns HTTP503 source_invalid. Only a read of the fixed projection; this does not prove broker delivery or change entity/workflow state. No query or GET body.

get.summary: Read legacy or explicitly paged immutable workflow audit
get.description: Existing workflow read policy. With no query retains legacy {items}, first100 events. With limit OR offset returns {items,page}, stable ascending version,id. Only those two query fields allowed. metadata.reason is optional, captured only from a validated declared text reason field on a new transition; no arbitrary workflow input copied or historical backfill.
